title: Shopping Cart Speedway
logline: Race customized shopping carts through chaotic, vibrant tracks packed with hazards and shortcuts in a fast, frantic quest for glory and redemption.

zones.name: Launch Pad
zones.description: Where the racers kick off their frantic journey, full throttle and ready to roll.

zones.name: Kart Gate
zones.description: A dramatic checkpoint shrouded in bold cel-shaded intensity, marking the start of the race proper.

zones.name: Glory Yard
zones.description: A chaotic stretch filled with environmental hazards and tight turns.

zones.name: Redemption Ruins
zones.description: An intense area full of shortcuts and perilous drops challenging racers' skills.

zones.name: Glory Grove
zones.description: The final dramatic stretch where racers push for the win, hearts pounding and carts flying.

plot.premise: In Shopping Cart Speedway, a retired racer returns to the wild circuits of chaotic, fast-paced shopping cart racing, seeking glory and redemption through intense, lap-based competition and cunning deployment of power-up items.

characters.name: The Retired Racer
characters.bio: Once a legendary kart racer, now returning to prove they still have what it takes.

characters.name: The Guide
characters.bio: Your mentor throughout the race, offering insights and commentary.

do.text: Welcome back, racer! The frantic circuit awaits at the Launch Pad.
Kart Gate reached. Keep your momentum high!
Glory Yard ahead—beware the slippery turns!
Redemption Ruins—cut through the shortcuts if you dare.
Power-up deployed! Use it wisely to gain advantage.
Final stretch in Glory Grove—push for victory!
This is it—the final lap. Victory is within reach!

endings.title: Glorious Victory
endings.text: Against all odds, the retired racer claims glory and redemption on the fast and frantic tracks of Shopping Cart Speedway.
